__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness.

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading.

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact, injected by the harness.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier (matches the team slug).
